heroBanner.heading: Transforming Talent Ecosystems
heroBanner.description: HireKarma bridges the gap between education and industry through smart technology and data-driven insights. From career readiness for students to hiring automation for companies and analytics for institutions, HireKarma connects all stakeholders in one intelligent ecosystem. Join the growing network of organizations, universities, and learners shaping the future of talent with HireKarma.

impactSection.heading: Our Impact in Numbers
impactSection.description: HireKarma delivers measurable results and lasting impact across India's educational ecosystem.

productsSection.heading: Our Products
productsSection.description: Explore our focused product suite designed to improve career readiness, streamline talent evaluation, and accelerate hiring outcomes.

problemStatement.heading: The Problem We Solve
problemStatement.paragraph1: Many students have potential but miss real exposure to industry workflows, tools, and expectations. Our skilling model closes this gap through structured training at our centers, with advanced technology labs and classroom facilities designed for practical, job-focused learning.
problemStatement.paragraph2: We currently train students for three active domains: Retail, IT, and Core Industry. From lab sessions and classroom instruction to industry-level projects, we make candidates job-ready and connect them with employment opportunities across relevant industries.

futureReadySection.heading: Future-Ready Implementation
futureReadySection.description: Built on cutting-edge technology and scalable architecture, our platform empowers institutions to adapt to the evolving landscape of recruitment and skill development. With AI-driven matching and real-time analytics, we enable smarter decisions, faster hiring, and seamless digital transformation across campuses.

testimonials.heading: Testimonials
testimonials.description: Hear from colleges, universities, and corporate partners who have transformed their hiring processes with HireKarma.

faq.heading: FAQ
faq.description: Have questions? We've got answers. If you can't find what you're looking for, feel free to contact us directly.

items.question: How does HireKarma help colleges improve placement rates?
items.answer: HireKarma connects colleges with top recruiters and equips students with industry-relevant skills, increasing their placement success significantly.

items.question: What types of roles does HireKarma recruit for?
items.answer: HireKarma recruits for entry to mid-level positions in tech, marketing, HR, operations, sales, and more across diverse industries.

items.question: Can companies hire from multiple colleges at once?
items.answer: Yes. Our Centralized Placement System allows companies to post once and hire from multiple colleges in real-time.

items.question: How are the funds utilized in the platform?
items.answer: Funds are primarily utilized for platform development, AI model training, infrastructure maintenance, and continuous feature enhancement. We also invest in training programs, student support services, and partnership development to ensure the platform remains cutting-edge and beneficial for all stakeholders.

items.question: Is the skill development program customized?
items.answer: Yes, HireKarma designs skill training programs based on student profiles, industry needs, and future job trends.

partners.heading: Our Partners
partners.description: Trusted by leading companies and educational institutions across India who rely on HireKarma for their campus placement needs.
